description: The image displays two horizontal bar charts comparing inference times (in minutes) for different methods across two models: Marco-o1-7B and QwQ-32B-Peview. Each chart shows five methods: Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner, represented by distinct colors (light green, yellow, gray, orange, and blue, respectively), with a legend at the bottom. In the Marco-o1-7B chart, the O1-Pruner method (blue bar) has the shortest inference time, approximately 1.1 minutes, while the Baseline method (light green bar) has the longest, around 2.15 minutes. The Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) and SFT (gray) methods have similar times, both around 2.1 minutes, and the DPO (orange) method is slightly shorter at about 1.4 minutes. In the QwQ-32B-Peview chart, the O1-Pruner method again achieves the shortest inference time, approximately 3.9 minutes. The Baseline method (light green) has the longest time, at about 6.1 minutes, followed by the DPO method (orange) at approximately 5.6 minutes, the Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow) at around 5.0 minutes, and the SFT method (gray) at about 5.9 minutes. The y-axis in both charts is labeled "Inference Time (minute)" and the x-axis is a linear scale from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The bars are sorted in descending order of inference time for each model.
